remove.with_check:
((auth.uid() = created_by) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wine_entries entries
  WHERE ((entries.id = post_shares.post_id) AND can_view_entry(auth.uid(), entries.user_id, entries.entry_privacy)))))

remove.policyname: Users can add comments for allowed audience
remove.with_check:
((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wine_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = entry_comments.entry_id) AND can_view_entry_standard(auth.uid(), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy) AND can_view_entry_standard(auth.uid(), e.user_id, COALESCE((e.comments_privacy)::text,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(e.comments_scope, 'viewers'::text) = 'friends'::text) AND (COALESCE(e.entry_privacy, 'public'::text) <> 'private'::text)) THEN 'friends'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(e.entry_privacy, 'public'::text)
        END)) AND can_view_test_authored_content(e.user_id, auth.uid())))))

remove.policyname: Users can add reactions for allowed audience
remove.with_check:
((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wine_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = entry_reactions.entry_id) AND can_view_entry_standard(auth.uid(), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy) AND can_view_entry_standard(auth.uid(), e.user_id, COALESCE((e.reaction_privacy)::text, e.entry_privacy)) AND can_view_test_authored_content(e.user_id, auth.uid())))))

remove.policyname: Users can read entry reactions for allowed audience
remove.qual:
(can_view_test_authored_content(auth.uid(), user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wine_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = entry_reactions.entry_id) AND can_view_entry(auth.uid(), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy) AND can_view_entry(auth.uid(), e.user_id, COALESCE((e.reaction_privacy)::text, e.entry_privacy))))))

remove.policyname: Users can view allowed entry group slides
remove.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (entry_groups g
     JOIN wine_entries e ON ((e.id = COALESCE(entry_group_slides.entry_id, g.anchor_entry_id))))
  WHERE ((g.id = entry_group_slides.group_id) AND (e.entry_group_id = g.id) AND (e.user_id = g.user_id) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id,
        CASE entry_group_slides.photo_type
            WHEN 'label'::text THEN COALESCE(e.label_photo_privacy, e.entry_privacy)
            WHEN 'place'::text THEN COALESCE(e.place_photo_privacy, e.entry_privacy)
            ELSE e.entry_privacy
        END) AND ((entry_group_slides.entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (split_part(entry_group_slides.path, '/'::text, 1) = (g.user_id)::text)))))

remove.policyname: Users can view allowed entry groups
remove.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wine_entries e
  WHERE ((e.id = entry_groups.anchor_entry_id) AND (e.entry_group_id = entry_groups.id) AND (e.user_id = entry_groups.user_id) AND can_view_entry(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), e.user_id, e.entry_privacy))))

        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(e.comments_scope, 'viewers'::text) = 'friends'::text) AND (COALESCE(e.entry_privacy, 'public'::text) <> 'private'::text)) THEN 'friends'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(e.entry_privacy, 'public'::text)
        END))))))
